title: Trump denies there's inflation; Talarico addresses illness conspiracy theories
summary: CBS morning report: Trump says there is no inflation and tariffs cause wealth; the reporter notes inflation is higher than when he took office, jumped after the tariffs, and is eating up wage gains.

assertions.quote: we don't have inflation and tariffs so cause inflation. You know what they cause? Wealth.
You know what they cause? Wealth. They cause wealth. We're richer now.
inflation is higher than when he took office. It was 3% then, it's 3.7% now.
Inflation also jumped after those tariffs

verdicts.note: Tariffs lifted goods prices, but CPI fell through 2025 and the 2026 jump coincides with the Iran oil shock.

Headline CPI rose from 2.3% in April 2025 to 3.0% by September 2025 and 3.7% by September 2026, and core goods went from -0.1% (March 2025) to +1.5% (September 2025); but core CPI is lower now (2.6%) than when the tariffs took effect (2.8%) and the 2026 headline rise is energy-driven, so the rise is real but mostly not in the categories tariffs touch.

Twelve-month inflation in the sampled consumer goods rose to 2.0 percent by February 2026 against a no-tariff counterfactual of minus 0.9 percent, a 2.9 point tariff contribution; the paper measures goods in the sample only and does not speak to headline inflation.
